headline: Approved home addition at 103 Essex Avenue and pool area changes at 100R Hesperus Avenue; several other projects were continued.
summary: Eight other applications were continued, seven to November 4 and one to December 2. Members also approved a resource area delineation at 19 Estuary Way and compliance certificates for 29 Farrington Avenue and 14 Brace Cove.
decisions: Approved the October 7, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 4-0.
Continued the elevated home project at 490R Washington Street to December 2, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the stormwater upgrade and parking lot repaving at 24 Kondelin Road to November 4, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the dwelling reconstruction at 37 Rocky Neck Avenue Unit B-1 to November 4, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the seasonal docks and gangway at 7 Sumac Lane to November 4, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the resource area delineation at 2 Beachland Avenue to November 4, 2026, 4-0.
Approved the resource area delineation at 19 Estuary Way, 4-0.
Approved the addition to the dwelling at 103 Essex Avenue, 4-0.
Continued the garage addition at 23 Concord Street to November 4, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the pile replacement at 6 Montgomery Place to November 4, 2026, 3-0.
Continued the home renovation and driveway expansion at 51 Wingaersheek Road to November 4, 2026, 3-0.
Approved the removal of the pool cabana and a new pervious patio at 100R Hesperus Avenue, 3-0.
Approved compliance certificates for 29 Farrington Avenue and 14 Brace Cove, 4-0.
Continued the ratification of an unissued 2016 certificate at 3 Welch Lane until a new filing is made.
